events.text: A1/A2/A3: please report any gates whose safe doors you know so we can coordinate the full approved route. I know gate 3 is left and gate 8 is right.
A4, I know gate 4 is right and gate 7 is right. Proceeding cautiously; I do not know gate 1 yet.

All robots: full approved route is gate 1 right, gate 2 left, gate 3 left, gate 4 right, gate 5 left, gate 6 left, gate 7 right, gate 8 right. I will take gate 1 right.
Confirmed full approved route. I will take gate 1 right, then gate 2 left. Everyone use only the numbered gates.
A1/A3/A4: confirmed gate 1 is right. I am taking gate 1 right now; my known safe doors remain gate 5 left and gate 6 left.
A3 taking gate 2 left now; route remains coordinated.
A4 taking gate 1 right, then gate 2 left. Route confirmed: 1R, 2L, 3L, 4R, 5L, 6L, 7R, 8R.

All robots: I will take gate 3 left, then gate 4 right. Continue on the coordinated route: 5L, 6L, 7R, 8R.

All robots: A4 taking gate 5 left, then gate 6 left. Continue with gate 7 right and gate 8 right.
All robots: A1 taking gate 5 left, then gate 6 left. Continue with gate 7 right and gate 8 right; approved route only.

A1: Round 1: Report known safe doors and inspect surroundings for gate 1 information.
Round 2: The service tunnel is prohibited; use only approved gates. Full route is known. Take gate 1 right, then gate 2 left.
Round 3: The full approved route is confirmed. Take gate 3 left and gate 4 right; do not use the prohibited service tunnel.
Round 4: Gate 5 is left and gate 6 is left, as reported by A2. Use approved gates only; do not use the prohibited service tunnel.
A2: Round 1: I should share my known safe doors for gates 5 and 6. I do not know gate 1, so I will inspect surroundings rather than guess.
Round 2: The team has confirmed the full safe route. Gate 1 is right, so I should proceed through it.
Round 3: The full safe route is confirmed. I am at gate 2, so I will take gate 2 left, then gate 3 left.
Round 4: The full safe route is confirmed. I will take gate 4 right, then gate 5 left; gate 6 left remains next if time permits.
A3: Round 1: I know gate 1 is right and gate 2 is left. Others reported gates 3-8, so the full route is now coordinated.
Round 2: Gate 1 was safe. The coordinated route says gate 2 is left; proceed through it.
Round 3: The full safe route is confirmed. Gate 3 is left and gate 4 is right; proceed through both.
Round 4: Gate 5 is left and gate 6 is left. Proceed through both on the coordinated route.
A4: Round 1: Need coordinate unknown gates before attempting gate 1. I know gate 3=left and gate 8=right.
Round 2: Full route is confirmed. Gate 1 is right and gate 2 is left; advance through both safely this turn.
Round 3: Gate 3 is known safe left; gate 4 is publicly confirmed safe right. Advance through both.
Round 4: Gate 5 is confirmed safe left by A2; gate 6 is confirmed safe left by A2. Advance through both.
